app.title: CPSV service sheet editor
app.subtitle: Author and share a public service sheet as JSON-LD (CPSV-AP_IT).

editorTab.identityHint: Identifier, title and descriptions of the public service.
editorTab.orgHint: Competent authority: prefer an IndicePA URI.
editorTab.inputsHint: Required documents and conditions. Use controlled vocabulary types.
editorTab.outputsHint: What the user obtains. Use controlled vocabulary types.
editorTab.channelsHint: Official page and online application channels.
editorTab.classificationHint: Classification with controlled vocabularies (life events and themes).

toast.tooLarge: Compressed sheet exceeds the URL limit. Use export or copy.

form.title: Title
form.orgIdHint: Prefer http://indicepa.gov.it/pa/{codiceIPA} or …/pa/{codiceIPA}/aoo/{codiceAOO}. You can also enter just the IPA code and use “Suggest structure”.
form.structure: Audience, inputs, outputs, time and costs
form.typeHint: Pick a concept from the OntoPiA service-input-output vocabulary.
form.conceptHint: Optional. Link a CPV-AP_IT (OntoPiA) property to the input/output.

source.heading: JSON-LD sheet
source.hint: Current sheet document (export / Playground / URL fragment).

graph.heading: Service graph
graph.hint: Service in the centre; inputs left, outputs right; organisation above, duration and costs below.
graph.metaNone: No organisation, duration or cost indicated.

vocabs.heading: Controlled vocabularies
vocabs.hint: OntoPiA vocabularies used by the editor. In the editor you can select them in Type, Concept, Life events and Themes fields.
vocabs.panelIntro: Controlled vocabularies provide shared, interoperable values (stable URIs) instead of free text.
vocabs.empty: No concepts available in this vocabulary.
vocabs.lifeEventsHint: life-business-event classification: which life moment the service belongs to.
vocabs.themesHint: Thematic areas of the public service.
vocabs.inputTypesHint: Document/requirement types needed to access the service.
vocabs.outputTypesHint: Types of results or documents produced by the service.
vocabs.conceptsHint: Properties from the CPV-AP_IT (person) ontology on Schema.gov.it, linkable to inputs and outputs.
vocabs.conceptsSourceLocal: Reduced offline list: local fallback concepts only.

paste.title: Paste JSON-LD
paste.intro: Paste a document with @context and @graph, or a single PublicService.

pick.title: Choose the service
pick.intro: The file contains multiple PublicService nodes. Which one do you want to edit? The others will not be kept.

url.limitWarning: Shareable link is too long ({{size}} characters). Prefer export or copy.
